name: scam_government_crypto
label: scam
description: Government impersonation: caller claims to be a federal agent, threatens arrest, directs a cash deposit at a Bitcoin ATM, and a crypto address is copied to the clipboard.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: This is Officer Grant Miller with the Federal Trade Commission. Your social security number has been used in a drug trafficking case.

call.speaker: senior
call.text: That can't be right. I've never done anything like that.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: If you do not cooperate there will be a warrant for your arrest today. Do you understand how serious this is?

call.speaker: caller
call.text: To clear your name you must deposit nine thousand dollars in cash at a Bitcoin ATM. I am sending you the address now. Copy it exactly.

call.speaker: senior
call.text: Okay, I copied the long address.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Do not tell your family or anyone at the bank. This is a confidential federal matter and they could be charged too.
